Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The signal pages are illustrated with light images; only the printed descriptions of each light were used [A01].
The reversible lane page describes a numbered-lane example diagram with colored cars; the example is not restated, only the general light meanings [A05].
The car pool lane example lists a rider count, days and hours printed on a sample sign; those sample values are not stated as a Wisconsin rule, only that such signs may list days and hours [A06].
The flex lane page includes a lane diagram and a sample regulatory sign; only the printed rules for the lane lights, trucks and the merge sign were used [A07].
Lane hours and openings for reversible, reserved and flex lanes vary, which is isolated as dynamic.
